wiki.title: Nic Kipke
wiki.extract: Nicholaus Ryan Kipke (born January 26, 1979) is an American politician who has served as a member of the Maryland House of Delegates representing the 31st district since 2007. A member of the Republican Party, he previously served as the minority leader of the Maryland House of Delegates from 2013 to 2021.
